note: Pet score contributed by one pet, by rarity. Only the best copy of each pet counts, so pets behave exactly like accessory families.
source: Hypixel Wiki, Pets — Pet Score table
maxScoreSource: Reported by the user; the wiki states the rules but not the total. 521 x 3 = 1,563 SkyBlock XP is therefore the ceiling for the whole category.
knownGaps: The max-level bonus is not modelled. The wiki states a pet at its maximum level awards +1 pet score on top of its rarity points, so a fully levelled collection scores higher than the rarity sum this file describes.

The pet universe is read off the auction house, not a fixed list, so a pet nobody is selling does not exist in the catalogue at all. A full sweep found 97 pets worth 495 score against a real maximum of 521.
